generation.explanation: Think of x² as an x-by-x square. Split 6x into two 3-by-x rectangles and place them along two sides: the shape is almost a square, but its corner is missing a 3-by-3 piece. Adding that area of 9 completes a square of side x+3, so x²+6x=(x+3)²−9.
